# MimBuddy

> MimBuddy is a standalone hardware device with a screen, built that way for safety. For hospitals: speaks their language, shows where it hurts, tells them what's next. For home: the therapeutic support hub of childhood.

## Pages

- [For hospitals](https://www.mimbuddy.com.au/hospitals): the bedside tool for supporting neurodivergent patients, from the ED to the ward. Book a 10-minute call.
- [For home](https://www.mimbuddy.com.au/home): the therapeutic support hub of childhood. Join the newsletter list.

## What's inside

- Customised social stories, like getting a blood test
- About me user profiles
- Support for activities of daily living during admissions and ED visits
- Visual routine boards
- Staff profiles
- Information about procedures
- Daily flow (for example, today it's an X-ray)
- Timers to help with waits
- Calming activities that up-regulate or down-regulate, depending on the patient's needs
- A feelings board, so the patient can talk about and process their feelings, connect with caregivers and communicate
- A pain scale board, with visuals to identify what their pain is and communicate it
- A mascot that talks to the patient in the language that best suits them, like English or Chinese
- The language of their support needs: declarative language for a child with severe PDA; safety and autonomy language around food for a child with OCD or fear-based needs
- Set up for eating disorder clinics (menu options) and physio programs (activities)
